Chapter 923: Chapter 21 Immortal Realm Consciousness (Please Subscribe)

The Origin of the Immortal Realm is located in the deepest part of the Immortal Realm, where the rules and pathways are as if substantiated.

Perceiving rules here is much easier than outside.

It’s much like an ‘open-book exam’.

Since Lin Yuan visited the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path has been waiting for Lin Yuan to come over.

For the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, since he couldn’t pose any threat to Lin Yuan, he surely intended to make friends.

Having one more ally is much better than having one more enemy.

Therefore, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path planned to thoroughly introduce the many wonders of the Primordial Lands after Lin Yuan’s arrival.

This was also the purpose of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s wait for Lin Yuan.

What the Ancestor of the Immortal Path did not expect was, Lin Yuan, before even entering the Origin of the Immortal Realm, had already fallen into a state of ‘sudden enlightenment’?

It is known, the higher the realm, the more difficult it is to achieve sudden enlightenment.

When the Ancestor of the Immortal Path stepped into the Twelfth Layer, he entered the Origin of the Immortal Realm and practiced arduously for a hundred billion years, ultimately with the help of the environment of the Primordial Lands.

He barely welcomed a moment of ‘sudden enlightenment’.

The talent and ability of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path were undoubtedly the strongest since the birth of the Immortal Realm; from nothing to creating the Immortal Cultivation System, and finally stepping into the Twelfth Layer.

In some ways, it was the Immortal Realm that limited the Ancestor of the Immortal Path. If he had been in the Main Universe, the limit of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path might have been even higher.

“Could it be that the environment outside the Primordial Lands is more conducive to ‘sudden enlightenment’?”

A ludicrous thought flashed through the mind of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

But it was immediately dismissed; the cultivation environment outside the Primordial Lands definitely couldn’t compare to the inside.

That Lin Yuan could fall into ‘sudden enlightenment’ before even entering the Primordial Lands only indicated that this Ancestor of Martial Arts had amassed too profound a foundation.

Far surpassing his own centuries-long ardent practice in the Primordial Lands, thus, even a slight stimulus from the Primordial Lands induced a state of sudden enlightenment.

“Just right.”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path nodded slightly, his figure appeared outside the Primordial Lands, looking distantly at Lin Yuan, planning to protect him for a while during his period of enlightenment.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path did not take advantage of Lin Yuan’s enlightenment to do anything; first, enlightenment is not a slumber.

If faced with danger, one would instinctively leave the state of enlightenment.

Second, what the Ancestor of the Immortal Path saw of Lin Yuan was merely an incarnation.

And even if it was an incarnation in a state of enlightenment, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path was currently unable to pinpoint Lin Yuan’s exact coordinates.

…

Time passes.

In the blink of an eye, more than half a year has passed.

“So that’s it.”

Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, his expression lively.

This period of sudden enlightenment greatly benefited Lin Yuan, allowing him to perceive hundreds of pillar-level fusion rules and elevate them to the Seventh Realm.

While the understanding of these pillar-level fusion rules of the Seventh Realm enhanced Lin Yuan’s power, it was not a transformative leap.

However, through these pillar-level fusion rules of the Seventh Realm, Lin Yuan had perceived the direction of the Chaos Rule.

This was crucial for Lin Yuan. Regardless of the evolutionary path, perceiving the direction of rules is important. With the right direction, persistence leads to success.

But with the wrong direction, or not knowing the direction at all, it becomes difficult.

“Chaos Rule…”

Lin Yuan took a deep breath as within his internal world, the power of numerous integrated rules intertwined and coiled, returning to the source, subtly forming the shape of an ‘egg’.

“Continuing to perceive more fusion rules, there is hope to nurture true Chaos Rules.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, realizing only at this moment the significance of the few explanations about Chaos Rules left behind by Xuanhuang and Moyu Tower Master.

When the foundation is there, the Chaos Rule will naturally be mastered.

Because—

Chaos Rule is not comprehended.

It is nurtured.

And the conditions for nurturing are the perception of thousands of rules.

…

“Ancestor of the Immortal Path.” Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted towards the distant figure in the Taoist robe, the gaunt old man.

During the period of sudden enlightenment, Lin Yuan was aware of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s presence.

If the Ancestor of the Immortal Path dared to make any threatening moves during Lin Yuan’s period of enlightenment,

Lin Yuan’s worst plan was to simply dissipate this incarnation.

Dispersing the incarnation does not mean the interruption of sudden enlightenment.

Fortunately, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path made no moves and even refrained from coming close to ensure Lin Yuan’s peace of mind.

“Ancestor of Martial Arts,”

Seeing Lin Yuan’s enlightenment come to an end, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path immediately stepped forward and appeared not far away.

“I originally thought that you would practice for a long time in the Origin of the Immortal Realm before you would experience a moment of sudden enlightenment, but it came even before you entered.”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path felt quite emotional.

“Lucky indeed.” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

“Luck?” The eyebrows of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path raised.

At their level, the so-called sudden enlightenment does not involve luck.

Regular accumulation is quantitative change, and sudden enlightenment is qualitative change, but without the previous quantitative change, there can be no qualitative sudden enlightenment.

“With the foundation of the Ancestor of Martial Arts, when do you plan to try for the Ancestral Realm?” The Ancestor of the Immortal Path looked at Lin Yuan, probing.

He could see that Lin Yuan was still at the Jade Immortal level, even though Lin Yuan’s essence of life was incredibly strong, yet he remained a Jade Immortal.

Although the Ancestor of the Immortal Path had never seen such a strong Jade Immortal, since it was a Jade Immortal, one must consider advancing to the Ancestral Realm.

The Ancestral Realm, also known as the Dao Ancestor Realm, is referred to as Ancestral Immortal Realm.

“I plan to accumulate a bit more.” Lin Yuan spoke.

Even if he intends to make a final leap, he will definitely choose to do so in the Main Universe, for it will once more bear a Chaos Void Origin Infusion.

And the Immortal Realm simply does not have this.

As a Twelfth Layer ultimate, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s realm strength is much weaker than that of a Twelfth Layer ultimate from the Main Universe, not only because there are no peers at the same level but also because stepping into the Twelfth Layer did not involve a Chaos Void Origin Infusion.
